paraphrased_finding: A single LRRCE-containing SLRP-like gene was reported in each of two Ciona genomes, no clear canonical LRRCE SLRP was recovered from Branchiostoma floridae, and several SLRP-like genes were already distinguishable in sea lamprey.
link_to_computational_result: Brackets a possible chordate precursor and early vertebrate expansion; supports treating lamprey as deep-lineage context and amphioxus gene-specific assignments cautiously.
caveat: The study used 2008 genome assemblies/annotations and does not prove the exact ancestral sequence or date of origin.

paraphrased_finding: SLRP classification combines protein/gene homology, protein modules and localization; LRR modules mediate matrix and signaling interactions.
link_to_computational_result: Supports interpreting conserved LRR architecture as family identity and interaction capacity, not as proof of a specific phenotype.
caveat: Review evidence; functional roles differ among family members.

paraphrased_finding: SLRPs act both as structural ECM organizers and as modulators of cell-surface and growth-factor signaling.
link_to_computational_result: Explains why conserved secretion and LRR architecture are biologically relevant beyond sequence identity.
caveat: Mechanistic review; do not assign every described pathway to every gene.

paraphrased_finding: Bgn/Fmod double deficiency caused low bone mass and increased osteoclastogenesis; both proteins bound TNF-alpha and RANKL and reduced osteoclast formation.
link_to_computational_result: Strong literature support for BGN and FMOD as conserved skeletal ECM regulators.
caveat: Double knockout does not isolate the full contribution of either gene alone.

paraphrased_finding: Fmod expression was highest in growing knee epiphyses and protein localized around late-hypertrophic chondrocytes, secondary ossification center and growth plate.
link_to_computational_result: Directly supports the expression-guided selection and the conserved secreted collagen-associated FMOD protein.
caveat: Mouse developmental localization does not demonstrate identical function in all species.

paraphrased_finding: Epyc expression appeared during cartilage development and its protein localized throughout the embryonic growth-plate ECM around resting, proliferating and hypertrophic chondrocytes.
link_to_computational_result: Provides the clearest direct anatomical rationale for EPYC despite moderate RNA abundance.
caveat: Embryonic mouse study; protein distribution extended beyond the cells actively transcribing Epyc.

paraphrased_finding: Human PRELP was characterized as an articular-cartilage matrix gene with a compact coding organization and higher expression in juvenile/adult than fetal/neonatal cartilage.
link_to_computational_result: Historically supports both cartilage relevance and the conserved compact coding structure observed computationally.
caveat: Human age pattern differs from mouse and should not be generalized across species.

paraphrased_finding: Mouse PRELP conserved the LRR, glycosylation and disulfide-bonded regions and was expressed in fetal and postnatal cartilage.
link_to_computational_result: Agrees with strong protein and coding-structure conservation while demonstrating species-specific expression timing.
caveat: The paper describes three total exons; the current computational figure counts two CDS-containing exons.

paraphrased_finding: The PRELP N-terminal glycosaminoglycan-binding region inhibited osteoclastogenesis through cell-specific internalization and NF-kappaB inhibition.
link_to_computational_result: Links the conserved secreted protein to bone-remodeling regulation, while highlighting possible functional importance of the N terminus.
caveat: Peptide/domain mechanism is not equivalent to demonstrating all full-length orthologs have identical activity.

paraphrased_finding: PRELP increased during osteogenic induction, and knockdown reduced osteoblast differentiation and mineralization through a beta-catenin/connexin43-associated pathway.
link_to_computational_result: Supports PRELP as relevant to both cartilage matrix and bone-forming cells.
caveat: Cell-culture mechanism requires in-vivo and cross-species caution.

paraphrased_finding: The vertebrate SLRP III family was conserved, but teleost OGN duplicates were retained and showed evidence of subfunctionalization.
link_to_computational_result: Directly explains why zebrafish OGN can be divergent yet valid and why teleost paralogy must be considered in orthology calls.
caveat: Does not validate the amphioxus candidate; the study focuses on vertebrate/teleost evolution.

paraphrased_finding: BMP-1/Tolloid proteases process pro-OGN, and processing enhances OGN regulation of type-I collagen fibrillogenesis.
link_to_computational_result: Links conserved secretion, termini and LRR-rich architecture to an ECM/collagen function.
caveat: Biochemical processing evidence does not establish growth-plate-specific function.

paraphrased_finding: Lumican increased during osteoblast differentiation/mineralization and shifted from cartilaginous to developing bone matrices during mouse embryogenesis.
link_to_computational_result: Supports LUM inclusion as a skeletal ECM gene and interpretation of its conserved signal peptide/LRR core.
caveat: Osteoblast model and embryonic localization are not direct matched growth-plate expression across species.

paraphrased_finding: Lumican knockdown in engineered cartilage increased type-II collagen accumulation and collagen-fibril diameter, supporting a role in collagen deposition and fibrillogenesis.
link_to_computational_result: Connects conserved LUM LRR architecture to cartilage collagen organization.
caveat: Engineered cartilage is an experimental model and the direction of effect depends on expression context.

paraphrased_finding: Osteomodulin/osteoadherin was secreted by osteoblasts, bound hydroxyapatite, promoted integrin-mediated osteoblast attachment and localized to fetal growth-plate primary spongiosa.
link_to_computational_result: Provides direct skeletal and growth-plate-context support for keeping OMD as a context gene.
caveat: OMD was not included in the full canonical protein/synteny/phylogeny panel.

paraphrased_finding: OMD enhanced BMP2/SMAD osteogenic signaling and bone formation; terminal LRRs contributed to BMP2 interaction.
link_to_computational_result: Shows why OMD's conserved LRR architecture may be functionally relevant to mineralized tissue biology.
caveat: Dental-pulp stem-cell and mandibular-defect models are context evidence, not direct growth-plate proof.

paraphrased_finding: SLRPs in bone combine collagen-matrix organization with regulation of growth-factor and inflammatory signaling, mineralization and remodeling.
link_to_computational_result: Provides skeletal context for interpreting conserved secretion and LRR architecture across the panel.
caveat: Review evidence; not every pathway applies to every SLRP or growth-plate zone.

paraphrased_finding: Bgn, Fmod and Lum showed overlapping but distinct expression across cartilage, bone-forming and other embryonic tissues.
link_to_computational_result: Supports developmental relevance while showing that these genes are not uniquely growth-plate-specific.
caveat: RNA localization does not by itself establish protein function or distinguish direct from secondary effects.

paraphrased_finding: OPG-Fc partly improved low bone mass in mature Bgn/Fmod-deficient mice but did not correct the complete phenotype and had adverse effects in young animals.
link_to_computational_result: Shows that the BGN/FMOD skeletal phenotype is not explained by a single osteoclast pathway.
caveat: Compound knockout and pharmacological rescue do not isolate the normal function of either gene.

paraphrased_finding: A PRELP N-terminal heparin-binding peptide inhibited osteoclastogenesis and reduced bone loss in several mouse models.
link_to_computational_result: Highlights possible functional importance of the conserved secreted N-terminal region.
caveat: Peptide pharmacology is not equivalent to the physiological activity of endogenous full-length PRELP.

paraphrased_finding: FMOD and LUM were localized in fetal cartilage rudiments and growth plates; MMP-13-cleaved FMOD occurred around hypertrophic chondrocytes and FMOD was more protease-sensitive than LUM in the tested systems.
link_to_computational_result: Connects conserved secreted class-II SLRPs to developmental cartilage remodeling.
caveat: Protease susceptibility and fragment localization do not establish a specific fragment-mediated signaling function.

paraphrased_finding: Recombinant LUM inhibited osteoclast differentiation, fusion, migration and resorption in vitro through reduced Akt activity.
link_to_computational_result: Adds a possible bone-remodeling function to LUM's collagen-matrix role.
caveat: In-vitro recombinant-protein evidence is not direct proof of normal growth-plate function.

paraphrased_finding: Bgn deficiency altered collagen fibrils and reduced skeletal growth/bone mass; combined Bgn/Dcn loss produced stronger connective-tissue and bone phenotypes.
link_to_computational_result: Supports a conserved BGN matrix-organizing role and demonstrates partial SLRP redundancy.
caveat: Whole-body knockout phenotypes do not isolate a growth-plate-zone-specific mechanism.

paraphrased_finding: Fmod-null tendon showed disorganized collagen bundles, irregular fibrils, more thin fibrils and altered LUM deposition.
link_to_computational_result: Directly connects FMOD to collagen fibrillogenesis and compensatory class-II SLRP biology.
caveat: Tendon evidence cannot be transferred uncritically to growth-plate cartilage.

paraphrased_finding: Epyc-null mice lacked a severe early phenotype but developed age-related joint/femur abnormalities; Epyc/Bgn double loss accelerated or strengthened disease and altered other SLRP transcripts.
link_to_computational_result: Supports EPYC in joint maintenance and genetically demonstrates SLRP interaction/compensation.
caveat: The study does not establish one specific molecular EPYC mechanism in the growth plate.

paraphrased_finding: The basic PRELP N-terminus bound heparin and heparan sulfate and contributed to fibroblast binding.
link_to_computational_result: Provides a mechanistic basis for considering N-terminal conservation and a matrix-to-cell-surface linker role.
caveat: Biochemical and cell-binding results do not quantify the function in living growth plates.

paraphrased_finding: Ogn-null mice were viable without an obvious gross phenotype but had thicker, more variable collagen fibrils and moderately weaker skin.
link_to_computational_result: Directly supports an in-vivo collagen-fibrillogenesis role while illustrating possible compensation.
caveat: Skin/cornea findings are not direct evidence of a growth-plate-specific mechanism.
